about: Hand-reviewed dated notices from land-manager pages (Step 3 review, 2026-10-31). Each 'quote' must equal a verified current_notice quote in access_facts.json (checked by tests). Dates come from the quoted text. A notice with no stated end date stays displayed, with its posted date, until change detection flags the source page for re-review.

wa-w-spanaway-lake.text: Spanaway Park closed to vehicles, boats and bikes (Fantasy Lights season) Oct 24, 2026 – Jan 11, 2027
wa-w-spanaway-lake.quote: Spanaway Park will be closed to vehicles, boats, and bikes from Saturday, October 24 through January 11, 2027, during the Fantasy Lights season.

wa-w-spanaway-lake.text: During the closure, walkers may enter the park daily 7–11 a.m. only
wa-w-spanaway-lake.quote: Walkers may enter the park daily from 7:00 a.m. to 11:00 a.m.

wa-w-angle-lake.text: Boat ramp closed (damage); fishing pier and ramp scheduled for replacement starting in January
wa-w-angle-lake.quote: The boat ramp is currently closed due to damage beyond repair.
